title: SteelSeries
offline: Device off, asleep or out of range
hint: Click a device icon for details. Right-click: refresh · Esc: close
debounceHint: Connection changes require two consecutive reads. Read errors are not disconnects.
historyRetention: Local history: 30 days. No data uploads.
busy: A read is in progress — try again.
hardwareHint: These are new values to set, not a readout of current settings. Only edited fields are sent after Apply. No automatic restore.
noControls: No supported hardware controls for this device or connection.
rgbExternal: Lighting is managed by OpenRGB. This plugin does not change it.
historyEmpty: No measurements yet. History uses actual readings only.
estimatePending: Not enough discharge measurements for a reliable estimate.
controlsOptInHint: Hardware controls are experimental and off by default. Opt in through Settings if you accept the risk. Enabling this option does not apply hardware settings.
